tagline: Leading Spanish insurance group with global presence
hero_kpi_rationale: Exceptional 42.9% growth in net income, demonstrating substantial improvement in profitability driven by better claims experience and significant investment gains.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated from insurance and investment activities.
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue amounts to €50.4 billion in 2024, up 4.2% compared to 2023, driven by organic growth and reinsurance.
kpis.signal: Stable customer portfolio growth and sound premium management.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses, taxes, and minority interests.
kpis.description: Net income attributable to shareholders reaches €967.5 million in 2024, a significant increase from €677.2 million in 2023.
kpis.signal: Strong net income growth driven by improved claims experience and investment gains.

kpis.name: Combined Ratio
kpis.explanation: Combined ratio of claims and acquisition expenses divided by premiums, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: The combined ratio improves to 86.6% in 2024, compared to 88.4% in 2023 (inverse of gross combined margin), reflecting more efficient claims and cost management.
kpis.signal: Improved combined ratio due to better risk selection and claims management.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin reaches 8.1% in 2024, up from 6.2% in 2023, supported by optimization of general and administrative expenses.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in operating margin driven by cost discipline.

kpis.name: Capex
kpis.explanation: Expenditures on tangible and intangible assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures amount to €300 million in 2024, a slight increase, primarily directed toward information systems.
kpis.signal: Modest capex, consistent with a low capital-intensive business model.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group.
kpis.description: The group employs 54,700 people as of end-2024, down 0.6% compared to 2023, despite targeted digital hiring.
kpis.signal: Slight headcount reduction, indicating process optimization.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of €0.1671 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of €1.183 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Proportion of net income distributed as dividends: 104.5% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Earnings per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2020-2024). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Mortality and Longevity Risk
risks.summary: Changes in mortality and longevity impact life insurance contracts over the long term. The longer the coverage period, the greater the group's exposure, although diversification mitigates impacts.
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at the beginning of the section (first paragraph), moderate language ('tend to take place') but cumulative impact over long duration. Stable compared to N-1. Industrial category weighs less than regulatory/cyber but critical for life insurer.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk on Contracts
risks.summary: Life insurance contracts guarantee fixed interest rates. If actual returns on financial assets diverge from these guarantees, especially over long durations, the group may incur significant losses.
risks.score_rationale: Positioned in early-middle of section, direct language ('This risk is more important'), impact quantified in sensitivity tables (7.1% OCI 2024). Stable. Capital category weighs heavily for insurer.

risks.title: Early Surrender Risk on Contracts
risks.summary: Policyholders may surrender their contracts before premiums cover initial acquisition costs. The group mitigates this risk through early surrender penalties and controlled acquisition expenses.
risks.score_rationale: Positioned in middle of section, moderate language ('risk that contracts are surrendered'), impact mitigated by penalties. Stable. Standard operational risk for life insurer, mitigated by contractual mechanisms.

risks.title: Non-Life Extreme Claims Risk
risks.summary: Natural disasters (storms, earthquakes, floods) increase claims costs in non-life insurance. Climate change could introduce material uncertainty into pricing assumptions.
risks.score_rationale: Positioned in middle of section, strong language ('extreme weather phenomena', 'natural disasters'), impact quantified (Ultimate loss -1% = 2.1% P&L 2024). Stable but increasing climate trend. Industrial category critical for non-life insurer.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Rate Risk
risks.summary: Fluctuations in exchange rates affect the value of the group's assets and liabilities, as well as cash flows from insurance contracts and reinvestment.
risks.score_rationale: Positioned in middle-to-late section, moderate language ('would affect'), indirect impact via cash flows. Stable. Capital category weighs heavily but group is geographically diversified.

risks.title: Asset-Liability Mismatch Risk
risks.summary: The group must align cash flows from its financial investments with those of its insurance contracts. A duration mismatch between assets and liabilities may generate losses.
risks.score_rationale: Positioned at end of technical section, moderate language ('aims to maintain exposure'), impact controlled via ALM. Stable. Operational risk well managed through explicit ALM policy.

ai_positioning.summary: Mapfre adopts a cautious approach to artificial intelligence, using it primarily for claims automation and risk analysis. The focus is on operational efficiency rather than disruptive innovation.
